name: Giganotosaurus: Complete Overview
description: Giganotosaurus ("giant southern lizard") was a carnivore dinosaur of the Late Cretaceous (99-97 million years ago), reaching about 13 m. Bigger than T. rex; hunted giant sauropods. # Giganotosaurus — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What does the name Giganotosaurus mean?", "giant southern lizard"),
    ("What did Giganotosaurus eat?", "carnivore"),
    ("What is name meaning?", "giant southern lizard"),
    ("What is period?", "Late Cretaceous"),
    ("What is lived (mya)?", "99-97"),
    ("What is length?", "13 m"),
    ("What is diet?", "carnivore"),
    ("What is found in?", "South America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
